verdicts.reason: A: the Meridian logo is blown up oversized and sits on the busy landscape outside the panel, jammed against the headline. The 'UP TO 40% OFF' badge is squashed into a tiny ellipse with illegible text, and the 'Find a Fare' CTA is shrunk so far that it is buried. B: the blue panel floods the whole canvas, so the sea and sky scenery is lost. The headline wraps to leave an orphaned 'sale', and the reading order is jumbled: badge, then CTA, then the body copy crammed into the right edge. Still, B keeps the badge and CTA in proportion and readable, so it is the less broken of the two.
